name: Rosanna
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hotel Rosanna is a charming alpine hotel in a classic, rustic style and is located directly on the pedestrian zone in the heart of St. Anton am Arlberg. The address is Arlbergstraße 63, 6580 Sankt Anton am Arlberg. From here it is only a few minutes' walk to the town's two main lifts, the Galzigbahn and the Rendlbahn. According to the operator, the town centre is right outside the door (0 m); lifts, slopes, ski bus and ski rental are each around 250 m away, and shopping facilities around 300 m. The interior is characterised by numerous beams and carved wood on the walls and ceilings and conveys a cosy, homely atmosphere. The communal areas include a bar and a lounge bar that has been well known for years and is regarded as a meeting place for many St. Anton guests.

History/Background

Reliable information on the founding history of the house is not available in the sources consulted. The hotel is now run by Alpeffect Hotels, a group with eleven properties in Austrian ski resorts, located within walking distance of the lifts and close to the village centres. Hotel Rosanna is explicitly aimed at an adult audience: the food and wine menu focuses on local specialities, and during the week activities for adults such as wine tastings or an après-ski with a music quiz are offered. Alpeffect Hotels welcomes guests from many countries, in particular from Scandinavia and the Netherlands.

Getting There

The location at Arlbergstraße 63 in the village centre makes the hotel a starting point for hikes and ski days in the Arlberg region. Lifts, slopes, the ski bus stop and a ski rental are each around 250 m away. Free but limited parking spaces are available in front of the hotel on a first-come, first-served basis. The reception is staffed daily from 07:30 to 10:00 and from 15:30 to 19:00; check-in is possible between 15:30 and 19:00, and for later arrivals the hotel asks for an email. Check-out is until 10:00.

Tips

Breakfast is served as a buffet with hot and cold dishes from 07:00 to 09:30; half board includes a 3-course menu with a generous salad buffet (18:00–20:30, three main dishes to choose from, children's menu available). Breakfast costs €18 per night and person aged 14 and over, half board €48 per night and person aged 14 and over if added to the booking. Allergies and dietary requirements such as vegetarian, vegan or gluten-free should be communicated before arrival. Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel, and the house is a non-smoking hotel. The tourist tax is not included in the price and is paid on arrival at the hotel.

Best Time to Travel

St. Anton am Arlberg is a winter sports resort, and the proximity to the Galzigbahn and Rendlbahn speaks in favour of a stay during the ski season. However, the sources consulted give no explicit information on the hotel's season or opening times, so no specific recommendation is given here.
